# BusyRealtor

> Real estate website builder for agents and brokers. Launch a professional property website in minutes with AI chatbot, interactive map, property listings, and appointment booking.

BusyRealtor is a SaaS platform that gives real estate agents and brokers a complete, customizable website with full admin dashboard, AI-powered chatbot, property listing management, Google Maps integration, and client communication tools. No developers needed.

## Pages

- [Home](https://busyrealtor.com/): Overview of features, pricing, and live demo
- [Register](https://busyrealtor.com/register): Start a 14-day free trial
- [Login](https://busyrealtor.com/login): Sign in to your dashboard
- [Privacy Policy](https://busyrealtor.com/privacy-policy): Privacy policy
- [Terms of Service](https://busyrealtor.com/terms): Terms of service
- [Sitemap](https://busyrealtor.com/sitemap.xml): Index of all tenant sites

## Features

- Property listing management with photos, status badges (active, pending, sold), and filters
- Interactive Google Maps with clickable property pins and live price/type filters
- AI chatbot powered by Claude or OpenAI — knows your listings, answers questions, books appointments
- Appointment scheduling with staff assignment and email notifications
- Admin dashboard with messages, appointments, stats widgets, and analytics
- Full customization: logo, colors, fonts, hero images, homepage section order
- SEO tools: meta description, Google site verification, sitemap generation
- Google Analytics integration
- Social media auto-posting (Facebook, Twitter/X) on new listings and sold properties
- Backup and restore
- Multi-tenant: each agent gets their own URL (busyrealtor.com/{slug})

## Pricing

- **Starter** — $29/month: Up to 10 active listings, public website, contact forms, admin dashboard, custom branding
- **Pro** — $59/month: Unlimited listings, AI chatbot, appointment scheduling, Google Maps, staff management, social integrations, analytics

## Live Demo

A working demo site is available at https://busyrealtor.com/demo-realty
